p: Ammonites: That is, who copied the Ammonites in language and apparel. The Hebrews thought that they were the Amalekites, but as it appeared by 2Ch 20:10 they were the Idumeans of mount Seir.
sea on this side Syria: Called the Dead sea, where God destroyed the five cities because of their sin.

to seek the LORD: This declares what the fear of the godly is, which is the prick to stir them to prayer and to depend on the Lord, while it moves the wicked either to seek after worldly means and policies or else to fall into despair.

gavest it to the seed of: He grounds his prayer on God's power, by which he is able to help and also on his mercy, which he will continue toward his, as he has once chosen them and began to show his graces toward them.
sword: Meaning war which comes by God's just judgments for our sins.
is in this house: That is, it is here called on and you declared your presence and favour.
are upon thee: We only put our trust in you, and wait for our deliverance from heaven.
before the LORD: That is, before the ark of the covenant.
the Spirit of the LORD in: Who was moved by the Spirit of God to prophecy.
battle is not yours: They fight against God and not against you, therefore he will fight for you.
bowed his head with his face: Declaring his faith and obedience to the word of the Lord, and giving thanks for the deliverance promised.
prophets: Give credit to their words and doctrine.
Praise the LORD: This was a psalm of thanksgiving which they used commonly to sing when they praised the Lord for his benefits, and was made by David, Ps 136:1-26.
mount Seir: Meaning, the Idumeans who dwelt in mount Seir.
destroy another: Thus the Lord according to Jehoshaphat's prayer declared his power, when he delivered his by causing their enemies to kill one another.

assembled themselves in the valley of: To give thanks to the Lord for the victory: and therefore the valley was called Berachah, that is, blessing or thanksgiving, which was also called the valley of Jehoshaphat, Joel 3:2,12 because the Lord judged the enemies according to Jehoshaphat's prayer.
fear of God was on all: He declares by this that the works of God always bring comfort or deliverance to his, and fear or destruction to his enemies.
Asa his father: Meaning, in his virtues, and those ways in which he followed God.

not taken away: If the great care and diligence of this good king was not able to utterly abolish all the superstition of this people, but they still retained it, how much less are they able to reform evil, who either have little zeal, or not as he had: though here he was not to be excused?
joined thyself with Ahaziah: Thus God would not have his join in company with idolaters and wicked men.
